t: This is St Mark's Church on Kennington Park Road, an Anglican church close to Oval tube station. It's a Commissioners' church, meaning it received a grant from the Church Building Commission, under the Church Building Act of 1824. It was built on the site of the old gallows corner on Kennington Common. John Harris, an English watercolour painter and illustrator, was buried here in 1832. He had been born in 1767, and his burial here is the connection I can tell you about.
